It covers "Sản phẩm vay theo lương" (product 01); whether it covers the current cash loan is unknown. Four years old and may be superseded. CONTRADICTS the 08/2026 TPBank schedule (3% / 1.5%).

insurance.name: Loan insurance (Phí bảo hiểm khoản vay)

mandatory.note: The FAQ gives the premium formula but does not say whether buying it is mandatory or optional.

percentOfPrincipal.note: Premium = insured amount x (2.5%/year / 12) x months insured; insured amount = 140% of the loan if term <= 24 months, 110% if term > 24 months. So it is not one percent of principal (7.0% of principal for 24 months, about 5.73% for 25 months, per the published examples). Source: https://tpb.vn/cn-vay-tin-chap-cho-vay-tien-mat-tin-chap-fico

fixedVnd.note: Depends on amount and term. Published examples: 10,000,000 VND over 24 months gives 700,000 VND; over 25 months gives 572,917 VND. Whether it is deducted from the payout or added to the loan is not stated.

latePenalty.value: Phạt và bồi thường 100.000 - 250.000 VND, thu khi Bên Vay không cung cấp giấy cam kết thanh toán trong 5-9 ngày (tùy sản phẩm) kể từ khi quá hạn; có thể phải bồi thường thêm thiệt hại phát sinh.
latePenalty.note: Paraphrase of the TPFico FAQ. Separately, a TPBank unsecured cash-loan T&C PDF (https://tpb.vn/wps/wcm/connect/e398ad3b-c635-45fd-95a4-444dcc3613ea/BM02.+TC_%C4%90I%E1%BB%80U+KI%E1%BB%86N+%C4%90I%E1%BB%80U+KHO%E1%BA%A2N+CHO+VAY+TI%E1%BB%80N+M%E1%BA%B6T_L10.pdf, document date not shown) says interest on overdue principal is at most 150% of the in-term rate and interest on late interest is at most 10%/year. Not confirmed to apply to TPFico loans.

products.notes: TPFico is presented on tpb.vn ("TPBank Digital") as a TPBank consumer-finance unit; its legal status relative to TPBank's licence was not verified here. No rate figure published. The insurance example (10,000,000 VND, 24 months, premium 700,000 VND) is a premium example only, not a loan cost example, so representativeExamples is empty.

researchNotes:
LICENSE: matches id 'tpbank' in data/licensed-institutions.json (NHTM Cổ phần, SBV list https://sbv.gov.vn/vi/nhtm-c%E1%BB%95-ph%E1%BA%A7n). The list's licenseNumber reads 'Giấy phép số 23/GP-NHNN ngày 25/5/2026', which looks like a recent amendment number; not verified here.
RATES: No product-level lending rate (cash loan, salary loan, overdraft) is published on any tpb.vn page that could be read; pages say rates depend on the customer profile. NOT used as product rates: (a) TPBank base lending rate for individuals (Lãi suất cơ sở KHCN, %/năm): 1 month 9.65, 3 months 11.00, 6 months 11.10, 12 months 11.20, shown on https://tpb.vn/cong-cu-tinh-toan/lai-suat (linked PDF 'Bieu LSCS danh cho KHCN_15.10.2026'). It is a benchmark, not what a borrower pays. (b) Third-party or old figures that disagree with each other: 1.6%/tháng and 70 triệu/36 tháng (VPBank comparison blog), 8.7-8.9%/năm and 300 triệu (Techcombank blog), 0.6%/tháng (tapchicongthuong.vn, undated), 1.6%/tháng and 10.8%/năm in tpb.vn 'cẩm nang' articles about 3-4 years old. Left out as unreliable.
CONTRADICTIONS: overdraft limit 500 triệu (product body) vs 100 triệu (page title, listing page); salary loan limit 1 tỷ (product page) vs 300 triệu (listing page); early repayment fee 3% / 1.5% (TPBank schedule 08/2026, unsecured) vs 7% / 5% / 3% (TPFico notice 2022). Each is recorded with its source.
FEE SCHEDULE: 'Phụ lục 02 - Biểu phí vay và phạt' (08/2026) was read with pdftotext; encoding is garbled but numbers are legible. Phụ lục 04 'Biểu phí dịch vụ tín dụng' and the general loan T&Cs exist on tpb.vn but were not parsed.
NOT COVERED: credit-card installment (cards listed at https://tpb.vn/khach-hang-ca-nhan/the-tin-dung, no installment terms read), Kredivo loan, 'Vay mua hàng trả góp', ShopeePay loan, Momo Pay-later limit T&C (2021 PDF unreadable). Mortgages, car and business loans skipped by instruction.
INSURANCE: only the TPFico loan insurance formula was found (2.5%/year on 140% or 110% of the loan). Whether it is optional or mandatory, and how it is collected, is unknown.
MISC: tpb.vn footers say copyright 2024 while content is current (fee schedule 08/2026, deposit rate table effective 19/10/2026). Page title and body text can differ (overdraft).
